title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety of Navepegritide Versus Placebo in Children and Adolescents With Hypochondroplasia
official: A Phase 3, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Trial Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Once-weekly Navepegritide Versus Placebo in Children and Adolescents With Hypochondroplasia
summary: This trial is being conducted to evaluate the efficacy, safety and tolerability of treatment with navepegritide subcutaneous (SC) injections once weekly in children and adolescents with hypochondroplasia aged 2 to 17 years.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Age 2 to \<18 years at randomization
* 2\. Clinical diagnosis of HCH with documented genetic confirmation
* 3\. Height measurement available from medical records

Exclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Evidence of growth plate closure
* 2\. Prior treatment with certain medication(s) which potentially could have affected growth
* 3\. History of any surgery intended to affect stature, growth, or body proportionality except procedures for leg bowing
* 4\. Unable to stand without assistance
* 5\. Known or suspected medical conditions other than hypochondroplasia that could affect growth
* 6\. Known history or presence of injury of the growth plates that affects growth potential of long bones
* 7\. Known history or presence of malignant disease
